result.title: Variational Approach to Optimal IPS Estimator for Multi-logger Off-Policy Evaluation
result.summary: We study off-policy evaluation (OPE) in contextual bandits with data collected from multiple logging policies. Inverse propensity scoring (IPS) is a standard approach to OPE and extends naturally to the multi-logger setting. However, as highlighted by Agarwal et al. [2017], neither balanced nor weighted IPS consistently outperforms the other in this setting. We resolve this dilemma by deriving an optimal IPS estimator with sample-dependent weights that minimize variance subject to unbiasedness. Using a variational calculus approach, we obtain closed-form optimal weights, yielding an estimator that is unbiased and achieves asymptotically optimal variance within a generalized weighted-IPS estimator class. Instead of a reward model, the estimator needs only a $K\times K$ matrix and a $K$-vector of moments, where $K$ is the number of logging policies, and we quantify how much efficiency this costs relative to the semiparametric oracle. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that our estimator generally improves on existing multi-logger IPS methods. We also extend our estimator to a doubly robust form by incorporating a conditional reward estimator. We compare the resulting DR extension with the semiparametrically efficient DR estimator of Kallus et al. [2021], both theoretically and empirically. We show that the two estimators achieve the same asymptotic variance when the conditional reward estimator is consistent, while our estimator can retain semiparametric efficiency under certain forms of reward misspecification. Empirically, the proposed DR estimator often achieves lower estimation error than the existing DR baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 研究多日志策略（multi-logger）下上下文 bandit 的 off-policy evaluation，用变分法在无偏约束下推导样本相关的闭式最优 IPS 权重以最小化方差，并给出 doubly robust 扩展及基准实验对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接联系，但其「多来源策略数据 + 无偏约束下的方差最优重加权」思路，可能可供核查用于由多个生成策略采集的 latent 推理轨迹的离策略价值估计与样本贡献分配。
